scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
